nurse.text: Hello, love. Come in out of the drizzle. Manchester's weather is mostly a character reference.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right, pop them on the counter. We'll sort them out before the next shower.
All done. Off you go. Keep your head up and your hood up.
The Ark's just there. Please don't store anything that bites.

else.text: No bother. The kettle's always on.
